title: schemas.checkpoint should carry structured closeout PR/CI fields (bundle bump 3→4)
body: Tick 0iz enforces the PR + CI close-out rule, but the pinned contract's schemas.checkpoint is additionalProperties: false, so the PR and CI facts ride the checkpoint's free-text reason and the typed refusal's message — a resumed run or a reader cannot parse them without prose-matching, the exact failure shape this project rejects. The next bundle version should add a closeout object (pr number/url/head-sha, ci state/failing-jobs) to schemas.checkpoint — a closed-object shape moved, which under the bundle's own versioning rule is a schema_version bump 3→4, mirrored in runstate.Checkpoint, the cloud factory's reader and the golden/invalid fixtures.
